_comment: Worker-protocol conformance vectors for the BackAI pull-worker (PRD R3). A reference worker (ref_worker.py / ref_worker.ts) registers a handler for each `kind` keyed by `behavior`; run.sh enqueues each vector's job and asserts the job reaches `expect_state` via the jobs API. PREREQUISITE: each `kind` below MUST be registered as a REMOTE job definition on the target stack (the runtime rejects enqueue of unknown kinds) — see README.md. `worker` tunes the reference worker's lease/heartbeat cadence so the heartbeat vector actually exercises lease renewal.

vectors.name: retryable_then_success

payload.note: fails on attempt 1, succeeds on attempt 2

vectors.description: handler throws (retryable) on attempt 1 -> River RETRIES -> attempt 2 completes

vectors.name: permanent_failure
vectors.description: handler raises PermanentError -> DEAD-LETTER (discarded) with NO retry despite the budget

vectors.name: payload_roundtrip
vectors.description: handler asserts the payload it received deep-equals what was enqueued; COMPLETES only if byte-for-byte identical, else raises PermanentError -> discarded

vectors.name: heartbeat_keeps_long_job_alive
vectors.description: handler runs (9s) far longer than the 6s lease TTL; the worker's 2s heartbeats renew the lease so the job COMPLETES rather than expiring + being re-leased
